full_prompt_en: A square, old-master-style oil portrait shows a curly-haired child looking upward from a deep brown, almost black background. The surrounding space is plain and unlit, with only a gentle brown halo of tonal variation behind the head; nothing in it suggests a detailed room or distant view. The child's shoulders and upper chest occupy the lower portion of the frame, while the head turns slightly toward the left and tilts upward. Wide dark eyes catch small highlights and direct attention beyond the upper-left edge, giving the face a wondering, absorbed expression. The nose and parted lips are softly shaped, and the cheeks carry a subdued pink warmth within the luminous ivory complexion. Loose brown curls gather around the forehead and ears, some catching amber light and others merging into the dark ground. A folded ochre-gold cloth lies across the crown, its overlapping ridges picked out by light while its farther folds sink into shadow. At the lower right, a warm mustard garment covers the shoulder and rises toward the neck, where a pale gray-white collar folds open in small, softly painted planes. The left side of the body dissolves into darkness, leaving the lit face, head covering, and shoulder as the principal visible shapes. The surfaces have a carefully blended, smooth painted finish, yet the cloth and curls retain enough uneven strokes to feel tactile rather than polished. Warm illumination descends from the upper left and front, concentrating on the forehead, nose, and near cheek before falling rapidly into the dark hair and clothing. The shadows are deep but graded, with no hard cast outline on the background. The overall composition sets a small, warmly lit expression within expansive darkness, using ochre, ivory, muted red, and umber to produce a still, devotional mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形古典大师风格油画肖像描绘一名卷发孩子从深棕、近乎黑色的背景前抬头仰望。周围空间简单而幽暗，头后只有一圈柔和棕色调子变化，没有细节表明是具体室内或远景。孩子的肩和上胸占据画面下部，头略向左转并向上倾。宽大的深色眼睛接住细小高光，目光投向左上画边之外，使脸上带着惊奇而专注的神情。鼻子和微张嘴唇由柔和明暗塑形，发亮的象牙色面容中，双颊有克制的粉红暖意。松散棕色卷发聚在额前和耳旁，一部分接住琥珀色光，另一部分融入暗背景。赭金色褶布覆在头顶，层叠的隆起由光线勾出，远侧折痕则沉入阴影。画面右下方，暖芥末色衣服盖住肩并延向颈部，浅灰白领口在那里形成柔软的小块折面。身体左侧逐渐消失于暗处，留下受光的脸、头部布料与肩膀作为主要可见形体。表面有细致融合、光滑的绘画完成感，但布料和卷发仍留着不均匀笔触，具有可触质感而非抛光感。暖光从左上与前方落下，集中在额头、鼻子和靠近观者的面颊，随后迅速退入深色头发和衣料。阴影深而有层次，背景上没有生硬的投影边线。整体构图把小小的暖光神情置于广阔暗色中，以赭色、象牙色、低调红色和深褐色形成静止、虔敬的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The image has the smooth tonal modeling of an old-master oil painting, with warm light emerging from a broad, nearly black field. Luminous ivory and ochre occupy compact focal areas, while umber and muted red deepen toward the edges. Rounded forms are built from fine, gradual value changes rather than outlined in a hard line; a few irregular painted textures remain where surfaces fold or curl. Highlights gather high and to one side, then fall away quickly into soft, layered shadow. The background is minimally described and visually continuous with the darkest contours, making the illuminated volume feel intimate and close. The overall effect is restrained, contemplative, and richly dark, with precise light placement carrying most of the visual drama.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有古典大师式油画的光滑明暗塑形，暖光从宽阔的近黑色域中浮现。发亮的象牙色和赭色集中于紧凑焦点区，深褐色与低调红色向边缘加深。圆润形体由细微渐变的明度建立，而非生硬线条勾边；在表面折叠或卷曲处仍留有少许不规则绘画肌理。高光聚在偏上的一侧，随即快速落入柔和而有层次的阴影。背景极少刻画，并与最暗的轮廓在视觉上连续，使受光体积显得亲近。整体效果克制、沉思而浓暗，精准的光位承担大部分视觉戏剧性。
theme_en: A curly-haired child looking upward from a deep brown background
theme_zh: 一名卷发孩子从深棕背景前抬头仰望
name: Carlo Dolci
